recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit as-is. No core source follow-up is needed unless a future generator or package validation run shows a regression in primitive StructureDefinition snapshot generation.
issue_request: FHIR-8311 was a Published/Persuasive DSTU1 correction for FHIR-core StructureDefinitions. It reported that primitive StructureDefinition snapshots such as integer were missing inherited Element content, then just id, and that primitive value elements used an unqualified path value instead of the rooted path such as integer.value.
initial_application: The Jira comment records svn revision 5495. Imported git history includes aa96a27941fb80451355fa2a0ccceaea9ab9f8bd, "#8311 - fix errors in primitive type profiles", which changed the historical ProfileGenerator to add the primitive id snapshot element and set value paths to type.getCode()+".value" instead of "value".
additional_context: The historical generator path no longer exists in the current checkout, and the datatype hierarchy has since been refactored so primitive datatypes now specialize PrimitiveType or derived primitives rather than Element directly. The active build configuration still includes primitive/datatype infrastructure, and current generated release history plus live build profiles show rooted id and value paths. No Zulip or Confluence evidence was found that changes or reopens this old correction.
reconciliation: No source change was made because the current specification already preserves the semantic correction requested by FHIR-8311: primitive snapshots include inherited id elements and their value elements are rooted under the primitive type name.

evidence_items.summary: Published/Persuasive DSTU1 correction saying primitive StructureDefinition snapshots were missing inherited Element id and used an unqualified value path.
evidence_items.learned: This establishes the final issue request and target semantics for primitive StructureDefinition snapshots.

evidence_items.summary: Historical #8311 commit changed ProfileGenerator to add primitive id to snapshots and use type.getCode()+".value" paths.
evidence_items.learned: The Jira request was explicitly applied in source history rather than left only as a Jira note.

evidence_items.summary: Current build configuration includes PrimitiveType as active infrastructure and current primitive rows such as boolean and integer remain in the datatype source spreadsheet.
evidence_items.learned: The primitive datatype definitions checked for this audit are active current-build inputs.

evidence_items.summary: R5 generated integer StructureDefinition has baseDefinition PrimitiveType and snapshot elements integer.id and integer.value.
evidence_items.learned: Later generated core profiles preserve the requested inherited id and rooted value-path correction.
